Gifted: Mimicry.name: Gifted: Mimicry
Gifted: Mimicry.description:
🧬 Mimicry, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you change in a few seconds, matching face, build and voice, and hold the form about ten minutes per hair or drop; your clothes stay your own.
📈 With training: stand-ins for people in danger, fooled scanners, a trusted face for the scared, slipped cuffs, a day as someone else, face flickers, a gang boss replaced.
⚖️ Wearing a face without its owner's consent is a crime.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit, as each form slips sooner the harder you push.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Himiko Toga (Transform).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Mimicry.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Mimicry family): Scale: from a hair or a few drops of blood, a new adult user takes the person's face, build, voice and height (within a head either way) in about three seconds. A hair or drop lasts about ten minutes, a vial of blood about an hour; one form at a time; samples spoil in a day unless chilled. Limits: clothes and gear never change. No copied Quirk, memories or skills; copied wings do not fly. Blood and scent stay the user's own, so a blood test, tracking dog or personal question exposes them; a hard hit briefly slips features back. Quirk Strain: light: quick change; moderate: form held under attack, partial change, ambush, leading people; heavy: smaller form, day-long cover; severe: signature carousel, a leader's place. Type: Transformation. Law: wearing someone's face without consent is impersonation and fraud; taking blood or hair by force is assault; heroes need consent or an authorized undercover operation.
